notes: The cohort block's design says the SECTOR cohort supplies the leave-one-out exposure, because its members route to the subject's valuation level (like-for-like premium ratios). The horizon-model loop-3 sweep said otherwise: 17 of 30 names had no admitted cohort leg, "too few substantiated leave-one-out peers." Root cause: pickCohort searched for kind 'sector' — a label no cohort carries. Sector cohorts are kind 'taxonomic' (the provider classification; cohorts.js itself finds sector by that kind).
